summary: One-frame sound event put on the thrower when a throw starts: the thrown entity, a sound-object selector and the sound event name. Created by ecl::thrown::SoundSystem::InitializeThrower (game bg3.exe+0x1E9D860, Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD5C060) and consumed by ecl::GameplaySoundSystem (macOS query ThrowerSoundEventOneFrameComponent + ls::SkeletonSoundObjectsComponent, i.e. posted on one of the thrower's skeleton sound objects). Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row).

fields.name: ThrownEntity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1E9EF30 (AllocRaw 0x10) writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle). bg3.exe+0x1E9D860 creates it on the thrower (pIVar13) and writes `*p = *pIVar16`, the parallel entity of the same iteration (the thrown object).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator writes dword 1 at +8. bg3.exe+0x1E9D860 writes uVar7 = virtual slot +8 of the system's sound helper (param_1+0x10) called with (world, thrown entity), and passes the same value to slot +0x18 to get the FixedString below - probably which skeleton sound object (enum, 4 bytes) to post on.

fields.name: SoundEvent
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF at +0xC; destructor bg3.exe+0x69EE80 DecRefs +0xC. bg3.exe+0x1E9D860 assigns (IncRef/DecRef) the FixedString returned by sound-helper slot +0x18 (world, thrown entity, field_8) - the sound event to post.
